exposure: cesarean delivery due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate
phase of labor at prior cesarean delivery
cohort: Women with a previous cesarean delivery due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate (NRFHR) at a university hospital between 2009 and 2016
finding: There was no difference in successful vaginal delivery rate between women with a prior cesarean delivery for NRFHR in the active vs. non-active phase of labor.
mod_finding: The study found that women with a prior cesarean delivery due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate had similar chances of successful vaginal delivery in subsequent pregnancies, regardless of the phase of labor during the previous cesarean.
